rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for a venue where sporting events are held.

example.english: We’re watching a football match at the stadium tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我哋聽日喺運動場睇足球比賽。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 hai2 wan6 dung6 coeng4 tai2 zuk1 kau4 bei2 coi3

rows.note: Use this for a large stadium, especially a well-known outdoor venue such as Hong Kong Stadium.

example.english: We’re going to the stadium to watch the Hong Kong team play.
example.traditional: 我哋去大球場睇香港隊踢波。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 daai6 kau4 coeng4 tai2 hoeng1 gong2 deoi6 tek3 bo1

rows.note: Use this more formal term in written or official contexts rather than ordinary conversation.

example.english: This year’s event will be held at the stadium.
example.traditional: 本屆賽事將於體育場舉行。
example.jyutping: bun2 gaai3 coi3 si6 zoeng1 jyu1 tai2 juk6 coeng4 geoi2 hang4
